query: (Cathay MD) Build a model to organise/optimise routes and service so Overall Rating > 7.

per_column.name: primary_service_complaint_category
per_column.rationale: The presence and category of a complaint is extracted from the same review text that drives the Overall Rating; a NULL (no complaint) versus any complaint category is essentially a restatement of whether the reviewer was satisfied. It is derived post-hoc from the outcome-bearing narrative and largely determines the rating rather than predicting it independently.

per_column.name: customer_service_responsiveness
per_column.rationale: Values like 'proactive_attentive' vs 'rude_dismissive' are sentiment-laden summaries of the review's evaluation of service, which is a direct component of the Overall Rating (Staff Service already exists). It co-occurs with the outcome and encodes satisfaction, not an external predictor.

per_column.name: ground_service_failure_signal
per_column.rationale: A boolean flag of whether the reviewer reported a ground-service failure is mined from the outcome narrative. Reporting a failure is itself an expression of dissatisfaction that maps onto the rating, so it restates/leaks rather than predicts.

per_column.name: service_quality_trend_signal
per_column.rationale: Labels such as 'cost_cutting_visible' or 'degradation_post_pandemic' are negative-sentiment complaints extracted from the same review; their presence strongly correlates with a low rating and is knowable only from the outcome text. This is leakage, not an independent predictor.

per_column.name: cabin_class_expectation_gap
per_column.rationale: This encodes whether the class experience fell short of expectation (e.g., 'business_class_food_gap'), which is a direct evaluative judgment feeding the Overall Rating. It restates the satisfaction gap rather than supplying an exogenous predictor; the class itself is already a column.

per_column.name: traveler_type_satisfaction_variance
per_column.rationale: This maps to traveler segment (solo/leisure/business/family) with an expectation qualifier. The traveler type is a genuine exogenous attribute known before the outcome and plausibly carries predictive signal about rating propensity, largely duplicating the existing 'Type of Traveller' column but framed as a segment feature rather than a sentiment restatement.

judge.rationale: Nearly all added columns are sentiment/complaint labels mined from the same review text that generates the Overall Rating. They restate or leak the outcome: complaint presence, service-responsiveness tone, ground-failure flags, degradation-trend labels, and expectation-gap judgments are all evaluative summaries knowable only from the outcome narrative and are effectively deterministic drivers of the rating. Only 'traveler_type_satisfaction_variance' resembles an exogenous predictor, and even it largely duplicates an existing column. As a set, they offer little genuine out-of-sample predictive leverage and would inflate model performance through leakage.
